project_name: Digital Agency Document Studio & Operations Engine
vibe: Modern, Sharp, Confident, Minimal, Premium, Technical, Trustworthy

typography.headline_rule: Headlines MUST be large, tightly spaced (-0.03em tracking). Two-tone structure: primary statement in dark ink (#201C18) followed by a secondary qualifier in muted gray (#78746C), ending with a single accent orange-red full stop (#C04C20) or question mark.
typography.headline_example: Streamlined Documents for modern studio operations.
typography.section_label_rule: All section headers, widgets, and field titles MUST use monospaced uppercase labels formatted like '... / 01' or '[01 / DASHBOARD]'.
typography.section_label_example: OVERVIEW / 01

layout_and_spacing.cards: Dark rounded cards (bg-[#2C2824] text-[#F2ECE0] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xl) or Cream elevated cards (bg-[#F2ECE0] border border-[#201C18]/15 rounded-2xl p-6)
layout_and_spacing.buttons: Dark pill buttons (bg-[#201C18] hover:bg-[#2C2824] text-[#F2ECE0] rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium text-sm transition-all duration-200) or Accent pill buttons (bg-[#C04C20] hover:bg-[#A63D17] text-white rounded-full px-6 py-2.5)

document_types.name: Invoice
document_types.desc: Tax invoice with line items, tax rates, payment status, and bank details.

document_types.name: Quotation / Estimate
document_types.desc: Project cost estimate with line-item breakdowns and acceptance terms.

document_types.name: Proposal
document_types.desc: Comprehensive agency proposal including scope, timeline, deliverables, and fee structure.

document_types.name: Statement of Work
document_types.desc: Detailed technical SOW outlining project milestones, responsibilities, and acceptance criteria.

document_types.name: Service Agreement
document_types.desc: Master service agreement outlining legally binding terms, payment schedules, and liability.

document_types.name: Non-Disclosure Agreement
document_types.desc: Mutual or unilateral NDA for client initial discussions and confidential disclosures.

document_types.name: Payment Receipt
document_types.desc: Official proof of payment for completed invoices or retainers.

document_types.name: Project Status Report
document_types.desc: Executive status update covering progress, completed milestones, blockers, and next steps.

document_types.name: Maintenance & Support Plan
document_types.desc: Retainer contract detailing monthly SLA, included hours, and support tiers.

document_types.name: Welcome Document
document_types.desc: Client onboarding guide detailing communication channels, key contacts, and tools.

document_types.name: Thank-You Document
document_types.desc: Post-project handover note with feedback request and ongoing maintenance options.

document_types.name: Official Letterhead
document_types.desc: Standard agency letterhead template for official correspondence and formal notices.

paper_styles.light_cream: bg-[#F2ECE0] text-[#201C18] border border-[#201C18]/15 shadow-2xl font-sans p-10 sm:p-14
paper_styles.dark_obsidian: bg-[#1C1815] text-[#F2ECE0] border border-[#3A3530] shadow-2xl font-sans p-10 sm:p-14

document_engine_specs.totals_block_style: bg-[#2C2824] text-[#F2ECE0] p-6 rounded-xl border border-[#3A3530]
document_engine_specs.inline_editing: Live click-to-edit fields on document canvas with hover subtle outline and instant update
document_engine_specs.pdf_export: Uses window.print() CSS page media @media print formatted for standard A4 / Letter document sizes with zero margins and full color backdrops

key_components.command_palette: Triggered via Cmd+K or search pill in top bar. Displays quick actions: 'New Invoice', 'New Proposal', 'Search Clients', 'View Unpaid Invoices'.
key_components.dashboard_stats: 4 metrics cards (This Month Revenue, Total Outstanding, Unpaid Invoices Count, Overdue Alerts) styled as dark rounded cards with accent numerical highlights.
key_components.clients_manager: Full CRUD client directory with quick search, multi-currency settings, default billing address, contact person, and document history.
key_components.business_profile_settings: Agency branding settings: agency name, logo upload/URL, registration number, VAT/Tax ID, address, payment details, default currency, signature line.

testing_attributes.rule: ALL interactive components (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, dialog triggers, actions) MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all React component files use .js extension. Load Poppins and IBM Plex Mono fonts via Google Fonts in index.html. Apply two-tone Poppins titles with orange-red terminal punctuation across all hero sections. Maintain strict contrast and use data-testid on every interactive element.
